detection_note.description: How Wazuh vulnerability detection and VMS findings relate on this asset
detection_note.title: Detection Note

AssetMerge.description:
Merge `source_asset_id` INTO the asset in the path: identifiers, services, findings and alerts move; the source
asset is retired with merged_into set. Audited; cannot be undone automatically.
AssetMerge.title: AssetMerge

state.description: monitored: a Wazuh agent AND a VMS scan in 30 days; partial: one of them; unmonitored: neither
state.title: State

execution.description: What actually runs for this collector in this installation
execution.title: Execution

ConnectorState.description: State of one internal connector, as established by the API. Never claims a connection it has not made.

checked_at.description: When reachability was last checked; null = never
checked_at.title: Checked At

ConnectorState.title: ConnectorState

NhaiJob.description:
One asynchronous NHAI request. Inference runs in a separate worker; the API only queues and reads jobs.
`result` is present only when `status` is `succeeded`; `error_code` explains every other final state.
NhaiJob.title: NhaiJob

missing_evidence.description: Phase 5: evidence that would change the assessment and is not in the bundle. Always includes the gaps found by the deterministic checker, whatever the model said
missing_evidence.title: Missing Evidence

validation_notes.description: Phase 5: every deterministic adjustment made to the model output (confidence cap, dropped statements, severity disagreement), so a reviewer sees exactly what was changed and why
validation_notes.title: Validation Notes

SeverityAssessment.description:
Phase 5 (additive): the model's evidence-grounded view of an alert's severity. Advisory only: it never
changes a stored severity; an analyst decides.
SeverityAssessment.title: SeverityAssessment

total.description: null when the source is unavailable; never a guessed 0
total.title: Total

WazuhAgentContext.description:
What the Wazuh connector reports for the asset's agent. `source` says where it came from (local fixture, live,
unconfigured or unavailable). Wazuh vulnerability detection is a separate method from VMS scanning.
WazuhAgentContext.title: WazuhAgentContext
